# Desktop local mode end to end: start the bundled server, log in, open the UI, stop on quit

## What to build

In the desktop app `apps/graph-manager-desktop` (KAN-86, spec `docs/prd/desktop-app.md`), implement **local mode**. The app forks graph-manager's server with Electron's own binary, waits for its port, logs in from the main process, puts the session cookie into the window's session, and loads the UI. The user never sees a login page.

Local mode uses the same data folder as a graph-manager started from the terminal (`~/.graph-manager`, the server's default) and logs in with that folder's own password file. It asks for port 7420 and lets the server fall back to a free port when 7420 is taken. When another graph-manager already runs on that data folder, the app shows "graph-manager is already running on this computer (port N). Stop it, or connect to it." instead of starting a second server.

On quit the server stops. When the server fails to start, or dies, the window shows an error page with the log tail, **Retry** / **Restart server**, and **Open log**. Only one instance of the app runs at a time.

In this task the app always uses local mode. The mode picker and remote mode come in the next task, and `settings.mode` is written as `"local"`.

## What already exists (from earlier tasks)

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts` sends `process.send({ type: "listening", port })` after `listen` when it has an IPC channel.
  - It writes `<dataDir>/server.lock` and refuses to start when another server runs on the same data folder: forked with IPC it then sends `{ type: "already-running", port, pid }` and exits with code 3.
  - With `GM_PORT_FALLBACK=1`, a taken port makes it listen on a free port.
  - It stops cleanly (and removes `server.lock`) on the IPC message `{ type: "shutdown" }`, like on `SIGTERM`.
  - It creates `<dataDir>/password` (the login password) before it sends `listening` when `GM_PASSWORD` is not set (`src/server/password.ts`).
  - It deletes `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` from its own env, and its Node children (runs, terminal shim) get the right runtime through `src/server/node.ts` `nodeCommand()`.
- `apps/graph-manager-desktop` contains:
  - `package.json` with scripts `build`, `typecheck`, `test` and `start`
  - `tsconfig.json` (NodeNext, `src/**/*.ts` and `src/**/*.cts`) and `vitest.config.ts`
  - `scripts/copy-pages.mjs`, which copies `src/pages/*.html` to `dist/pages/`
  - `src/settings.ts`: `readSettings(dir)` and `writeSettings(dir, s)`; the settings have `mode`, `remoteUrl` and `bounds` (no password)
  - `src/links.ts`: `classifyLink(url, appOrigin, "open" | "navigate")` → `"same-window" | "new-window" | "external" | "deny"`
  - `src/shellEnv.ts`: `resolvePath({ platform, env, home, exec?, log? })` → `Promise<string | undefined>`
  - `src/paths.ts`: `bundledPaths({ packaged, resourcesPath?, resolvePackageJson? })` → `{ serverEntry, graphExecutionCli }`
  - a placeholder `src/main.ts`, which this task replaces

Read those files before starting.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts`:
  - lines 108–147: `POST /api/auth/login` takes `{ password }`. On success it answers `204` with `Set-Cookie: gm_session=<value>; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=...`. After 10 failures per IP in 15 minutes it answers `429`.
  - lines 89–100: `originAllowed`. A request without an `Origin` header is allowed, so a Node `fetch` from the main process passes.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/config.ts` (lines 55–83): the env variables `GM_PASSWORD`, `GM_PORT`, `GM_HOST`, `GM_DATA_DIR`, `GM_WORKSPACES_DIR` and `GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN`. The default workspaces dir is `<home>/graph-manager-workspaces`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts`: the `isMain` block handles `SIGINT`, `SIGTERM` and the IPC `{ type: "shutdown" }` with `close()` and then `process.exit(0)`; it maps `AlreadyRunningError` to the `already-running` IPC message and exit code 3.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/password.ts`: `PASSWORD_FILE = "password"`; the password is the trimmed file content.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/lock.ts`: `LOCK_FILE = "server.lock"`, JSON `{ pid, port, host, startedAt }`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/health.ts`: `GET /healthz` (no auth) and `GET /api/health` (needs the session).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/test-helpers.ts` (`cookieOf`, near the end): how tests take `name=value` from a `Set-Cookie` header.

## Patterns to follow

**Dependency injection for testability:** `localServer.ts` gets `fork` and `fetch` as options with real defaults, so vitest can start the real graph-manager server under plain Node (`execPath: process.execPath`) without Electron.

**Logging:** append-only files under `<userData>/logs/`, opened with `fs.createWriteStream(file, { flags: "a" })`.

**Electron security defaults** for every window that shows graph-manager's pages:
```typescript
webPreferences: { contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true, nodeIntegration: false }
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager-desktop/src/localServer.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```typescript
  export interface LocalServerOptions {
    serverEntry: string; graphExecutionCli: string;
    /** The data folder the server will use: env.GM_DATA_DIR, else <home>/.graph-manager. Only read here (password file). */
    dataDir: string;
    logFile: string; env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv; execPath: string; electron: boolean;
    fork?: typeof import("node:child_process").fork; startTimeoutMs?: number; // default 30000
  }
  export interface RunningServer { port: number; pid: number; origin: string; exited: Promise<number | null>; stop(): Promise<void> }
  /** Thrown when another graph-manager already runs on the data folder. */
  export class AlreadyRunning extends Error { constructor(readonly port: number, readonly pid: number) }
  /** Forks graph-manager and resolves when it reports its port; rejects with AlreadyRunning, or with the log tail if it exits or times out first. */
  export async function startLocalServer(o: LocalServerOptions): Promise<RunningServer>
  /** The env for the server child (pure, unit-tested). */
  export function serverEnv(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, graphExecutionCli: string, electron: boolean): NodeJS.ProcessEnv
  /** The data folder local mode uses: env.GM_DATA_DIR (resolved), else path.join(home, ".graph-manager"). */
  export function localDataDir(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, home: string): string
  /** The workspaces folder: env.GM_WORKSPACES_DIR (resolved), else path.join(home, "graph-manager-workspaces"). */
  export function localWorkspacesDir(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, home: string): string
  /** The trimmed content of <dataDir>/password; throws "no password file in <dataDir>" when missing or blank. */
  export function readLocalPassword(dataDir: string): string
  /** POSTs the password to /api/auth/login and returns the gm_session cookie value; throws with the status on failure. */
  export async function loginCookie(origin: string, password: string, fetchImpl = fetch): Promise<string>
  /** The last n lines of a log file ("" when missing). */
  export function logTail(file: string, n = 20): string
  /** Renames <file> to <file>.1 when it is larger than maxBytes (5 MB). */
  export function rotateLog(file: string, maxBytes = 5 * 1024 * 1024): void
  ```
- `startLocalServer`:
  - Call `rotateLog`, then open `logFile` for append.
  - `fork(serverEntry, [], { execPath, env: serverEnv(env, graphExecutionCli, electron), stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe", "ipc"] })`.
  - `serverEnv`: a copy of `env` **without** `GM_PASSWORD` and `GM_PORT` (so the server uses its saved password file and its default port 7420), plus `GM_HOST: "127.0.0.1"`, `GM_PORT_FALLBACK: "1"`, `GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN: graphExecutionCli`, and `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1"` only when `electron` is true. `GM_DATA_DIR` and `GM_WORKSPACES_DIR` are **not** set by the app: when `env` has them (the smoke test, a developer) they pass through unchanged, otherwise the server's defaults `~/.graph-manager` and `~/graph-manager-workspaces` apply, the same folders as `npm start`.
  - Pipe stdout and stderr to the log.
  - Resolve on the `message` event where `msg.type === "listening"` and `typeof msg.port === "number"`.
  - Reject with `new AlreadyRunning(msg.port, msg.pid)` on `msg.type === "already-running"` (the child exits with code 3 by itself; wait for its `exit` before rejecting).
  - Reject on `exit` (without one of those messages) or timeout with `Error("graph-manager did not start:\n" + logTail(logFile))`, and kill the child on timeout.
  - `stop()` sends the IPC message `child.send({ type: "shutdown" })` on **every** OS (if the channel is still connected) and waits up to 5 s for exit. The server then closes cleanly and removes `server.lock`.
    - On POSIX, if it's still running, `child.kill("SIGKILL")`.
    - On win32, if it's still running, `execFile("taskkill", ["/pid", String(pid), "/T", "/F"])`. That kills terminals and runs started by the server too.
    - Don't use `SIGTERM`: on Windows `child.kill()` ends the process at once without running the server's handler, so the lock file would stay behind.
    - Resolves when the child has exited.
- `loginCookie`:
  - `fetchImpl(origin + "/api/auth/login", { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ password }) })`.
  - Require status `204`. Read `res.headers.getSetCookie()` and find `gm_session=...`; return the value before the first `;`. Throw `Error("login failed: HTTP <status>")` otherwise.
- **GOTCHA**: Don't send an `Origin` header; the server's same-origin check allows its absence. Don't log the password.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/localServer.test.ts` (in `apps/graph-manager-desktop`)

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager-desktop/src/localServer.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** (the real server, under plain Node):
  - `beforeAll`: require `apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js` to exist. Resolve it with `bundledPaths({ packaged: false })`. If it's missing, fail with "run npm run build -w graph-manager first". `.github/workflows/qa.yml` already runs `npm run build` before `npm test`, so CI has it.
  - Start with `execPath: process.execPath`, `electron: false`, a temp `logFile`, and `env: { ...process.env, GM_DATA_DIR: <tmp>/data, GM_WORKSPACES_DIR: <tmp>/ws, GM_DOCKER_SOCKET: <tmp>/none.sock, GM_PASSWORD: "ignored" }`, `dataDir: <tmp>/data`. Expect `port > 0`, and `fetch(origin + "/healthz")` gives 200. (The test can't rely on port 7420 being free; whatever port it gets is fine.)
  - `readLocalPassword(<tmp>/data)` returns the server-generated password (not `"ignored"`: `GM_PASSWORD` is stripped). `loginCookie(origin, thatPassword)` returns a non-empty string. `fetch(origin + "/api/health", { headers: { cookie: "gm_session=" + value } })` gives 200. Without the cookie it gives 401.
  - `loginCookie(origin, "wrong")` rejects with `/HTTP 401/`.
  - `<tmp>/data/server.lock` exists while it runs. `stop()` resolves, afterwards `fetch(origin + "/healthz")` rejects and `server.lock` is gone (the IPC shutdown ran the server's clean close).
  - Already running: start a first server on `<tmp>/data`, then a second `startLocalServer` with the same `GM_DATA_DIR` rejects with `AlreadyRunning` whose `port` is the first one's port; no second server process stays alive.
  - `serverEnv` (pure): `serverEnv({ GM_PORT: "1", GM_PASSWORD: "x", PATH: "/a" }, "/c.js", false)` has no `GM_PORT`/`GM_PASSWORD`, has `GM_PORT_FALLBACK: "1"`, `GM_HOST: "127.0.0.1"`, `GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN: "/c.js"`, no `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`; with `electron: true` it has `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1"`; `GM_DATA_DIR`/`GM_WORKSPACES_DIR` pass through when present and are absent when not. (The server's own tests cover the fallback itself.)
  - `localDataDir({}, home)` is `path.join(home, ".graph-manager")`; with `GM_DATA_DIR` it's that path resolved. Same for `localWorkspacesDir`.
  - A missing entry file (`serverEntry: <tmp>/nope.js`) rejects, and the message contains "graph-manager did not start".
  - `rotateLog` and `logTail` on temp files.
  - Timeout 60 s for the file.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager-desktop/src/pages/error.html`

- A plain HTML page with inline CSS. It uses system fonts, a light and a dark theme through `prefers-color-scheme`, and no external resources.
- It reads its content from the URL query: `title`, `detail` (preformatted log tail) and `actions` (comma list of `retry`, `restart`, `log`, `change`).
- Buttons call `window.gmDesktop.action("<name>")`, which the preload exposes.
- Button labels: **Retry**, **Restart server**, **Open log**, **Change server**, **Connect to it** (`connect`), **Run on this computer** (`local`). Only the buttons named in `actions` appear, in that order of `actions`. `change` and `local` are used by a later task.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager-desktop/src/preload.cts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `const { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require("electron"); contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld("gmDesktop", { action: (name: string) => ipcRenderer.invoke("gm:action", name) });`
- **GOTCHA**: Sandboxed preloads must be CommonJS. The `.cts` extension compiles to `dist/preload.cjs` with NodeNext. Load this preload **only** in windows that show the app's own `dist/pages/*.html`, never in a window showing graph-manager.

### REPLACE `apps/graph-manager-desktop/src/main.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  1. `if (!app.requestSingleInstanceLock()) app.quit();` On `second-instance`, restore and focus the main window.
  2. On `app.whenReady()`:
     - `userData = app.getPath("userData")`.
     - On macOS, `process.env.PATH = await resolvePath({ platform: process.platform, env: process.env, home: os.homedir(), log })`. `log` appends to `<userData>/logs/main.log`.
  3. `writeSettings` with `mode: "local"`, keeping the other fields. `dataDir = localDataDir(process.env, os.homedir())`.
  4. `const { serverEntry, graphExecutionCli } = bundledPaths({ packaged: app.isPackaged, resourcesPath: process.resourcesPath })`.
  5. `startLocalServer` with:
     - `execPath: process.execPath`, `electron: true`, `env: process.env`, `dataDir`
     - `logFile: path.join(userData, "logs", "server.log")`
  6. `value = await loginCookie(origin, readLocalPassword(dataDir))`. Then `await session.fromPartition("persist:local").cookies.set({ url: origin + "/", name: "gm_session", value, httpOnly: true, sameSite: "strict", expirationDate: Date.now() / 1000 + 30 * 24 * 3600 })`.
  7. Main window:
     - `BrowserWindow` 1280×800, `minWidth: 900`, `minHeight: 600`. Use `settings.bounds` when it's set, and save the bounds on `close`.
     - `webPreferences: { partition: "persist:local", contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true, nodeIntegration: false }`.
     - Load `origin + "/"`.
  8. Links. `webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(({ url }) => ...)` with `classifyLink(url, origin, "open")`:
     - `new-window` → `{ action: "allow", overrideBrowserWindowOptions: { width: 1200, height: 800, webPreferences: { partition: "persist:local", contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true, nodeIntegration: false } } }`
     - `external` → `shell.openExternal(url)` and `{ action: "deny" }`
     - otherwise → `{ action: "deny" }`
     - Register `will-navigate` too: when `classifyLink(url, origin, "navigate")` isn't `same-window`, call `event.preventDefault()` and open `external` URLs with `shell.openExternal`. Apply the same handlers to child windows with `app.on("web-contents-created", ...)`.
  9. Already running. When `startLocalServer` rejects with `AlreadyRunning`, load `dist/pages/error.html` with `title="graph-manager is already running on this computer (port <N>). Stop it, or connect to it."`, no `detail`, and `actions=connect,retry`. The `connect` action (**Connect to it**) is stored as `pendingConnect = "http://127.0.0.1:<N>"` and handled in `gm:action`: here, in this task, it saves `mode: "remote"` and `remoteUrl` and loads that URL in a main window with the `persist:remote` partition and the same `webPreferences` and link handlers (with `appOrigin` = that URL) as local mode. A later task replaces this with the full remote mode. `retry` starts local mode again.
  10. Errors. When `startLocalServer` rejects otherwise, load `dist/pages/error.html` with `title="graph-manager did not start"`, `detail=<message>` and `actions=retry,log` into a window that has the preload (`webPreferences: { preload: <dist>/preload.cjs, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true }`). When the running server's `exited` resolves while the app isn't quitting, show `title="The local server stopped."`, the log tail and `actions=restart,log`.
     - `ipcMain.handle("gm:action", ...)`:
       - `retry` / `restart` → start again and load the UI in the same window
       - `log` → `shell.openPath(logFile)`
     - Only accept `gm:action` from the app's own pages: check `event.senderFrame.url` starts with `file:`.
     - Use separate windows, or change `webPreferences` by recreating the window. A window with the preload must never load the server's origin.
  11. Quit. On `before-quit`, if the server is running, call `event.preventDefault()`, `await server.stop()`, then `app.quit()` again; use a flag to avoid a loop. `window-all-closed` → `app.quit()` on all platforms. Closing the window quits the app and stops the server.
  12. The window title follows the page (`page-title-updated` is left at its default).
- **IMPORTS**: from `electron`: `app`, `BrowserWindow`, `ipcMain`, `session`, `shell`. Plus `node:os`, `node:path` and `node:url` (`fileURLToPath`), and the local modules with `.js` extensions (`./localServer.js`, `./settings.js`, `./links.js`, `./shellEnv.js`, `./paths.js`).
- **GOTCHA**: `process.execPath` in the packaged app is the app binary, and in dev it's `node_modules/electron/dist/...`. Both work as `execPath` with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`. Never fork with a `node` found on `PATH`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-manager-desktop && npm run typecheck -w graph-manager-desktop`

### Manual check (macOS dev)

- `npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager && npm start -w graph-manager-desktop`. The graph-manager UI opens with no login page.
- `ps -ax | grep dist/server/main.js` shows the server child. After quitting the app it's gone.
- If you can't open a GUI in your environment, skip this step and say so in your report. The unit tests and a later CI smoke test cover it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `startLocalServer` + `loginCookie` work against the real graph-manager server in vitest under plain Node: the port is reported, `/api/health` gives 200 with the cookie and 401 without it, and the server is down after `stop()`.
- [ ] The server child gets `GM_HOST=127.0.0.1`, `GM_PORT_FALLBACK=1`, `GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN=<bundled cli.js>`, and `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` only under Electron; no `GM_PASSWORD` and no `GM_PORT`; `GM_DATA_DIR`/`GM_WORKSPACES_DIR` only when the app's own env has them. So by default it uses `~/.graph-manager`, `~/graph-manager-workspaces` and port 7420 (or a free port when 7420 is taken).
- [ ] The app logs in with `<dataDir>/password`, the same password `npm start` prints.
- [ ] With a graph-manager already running on the same data folder, local mode shows "graph-manager is already running on this computer (port N). Stop it, or connect to it." with **Connect to it** and **Retry**, and leaves no second server process. **Connect to it** loads `http://127.0.0.1:N` in a `persist:remote` window.
- [ ] Server output goes to `<userData>/logs/server.log`, rotated at 5 MB.
- [ ] A start failure shows `error.html` with the log tail, **Retry** and **Open log**. A crash shows "The local server stopped." with **Restart server**.
- [ ] Quitting stops the server through the IPC `{ type: "shutdown" }` (so `server.lock` is removed), with a forced kill after 5 s (`SIGKILL`, or `taskkill /T /F` on Windows).
- [ ] A second launch focuses the first window.
- [ ] Same-origin `window.open` gets a new app window with the `persist:local` partition. Other http(s) links open in the default browser. `file:` and `javascript:` are denied.
- [ ] Root checks pass: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test`.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager && npm run build -w graph-manager-desktop
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager-desktop
```
